item.title: Home inspections available for lead and copper water pipes
item.description: WELLINGTON — Wellington City has received a grant to pay for the replacement of any residential lead or copper water pipes that connect to houses from the water meter. Jones & DeMille Engineering will be doing the work for this project. The grant covers the entire cost of replacing the pipe, including restoring the land back to its prior condition. item.description: PRICE – What began as a proactive idea to improve a local motocross track has grown into one of Utah’s most active grassroots racing series.
